reviews.author: Poonkuzhali Gunasekaran
reviews.text:
Dr. Aishwarya is not just an expert in the field; she is a compassionate and approachable doctor who goes above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and understood – even during the frustrating and hard times that can arise with IVF. The level of expertise and knowledge demonstrated by Dr. Aishwarya instilled confidence in us, and we knew we were in capable hands. Just trust her decisions and follow her instructions and you’ll get what you’re dreaming for. Her knowledge and experience are so helpful and make you feel you’re in good hands. Our journey with her has been nothing short of miraculous.
Our gratitude knows no bounds as we are 33 weeks pregnant with healthy babies due in March 2024. This dream would never be possible without Dr. Aishwarya. We wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Aishwarya to anyone on a similar path, searching for not just medical expertise but a compassionate partner in their quest for parenthood. Thank you, Dr. Aishwarya for being our miracle worker, and giving us the greatest joy of our lives. You’ve literally made our dreams come true and we are forever grateful.

reviews.author: Pearlin C P
reviews.text: Although she is young, Aishwarya's expertise is exceptional, having been trained at prestigious institutions like AIIMS, JIPMER, and MMM Fertility Research. Her experience and skills are evident in the way she approaches every case with confidence and precision. What truly sets her apart is the personal attention she gives to each patient. She has a warm, friendly manner of communicating that makes you feel as if she’s part of your own family. Her compassionate and professional care is truly commendable, and I highly recommend her to anyone seeking both expertise and a human touch in their medical care.

reviews.author: Saranya Balasubramanian
reviews.text: Dr. Aishwarya is kind, knowledgeable, and practical. The clinic staff are quick to think and execute. Overall,  I will refer over and over, and go to Accumed for all my obgyn needs
